messages.content: What wheather is now in Moscow, in celsius?

function.name: uber_eat_order
function.description: Place an order for food delivery on Uber Eats by specifying the restaurant and the items with their respective quantities. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

restaurant.description: The name of the restaurant from which to order food.

items.description: A list of food item names selected for the order.

quantities.description: A list of quantities for each food item, corresponding by index to the items array.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time weather data. You can check a reliable weather service (e.g., the Weather Channel, AccuWeather, or a local Russian meteorological site) for the current temperature in Moscow.

We can respond with a general answer or we can say we don't have real-time data. According to policy, we should not hallucinate. We can say we don't have real-time data. But maybe we can approximate? No, we should not guess. So we should respond that we cannot provide real-time weather. We can suggest checking a weather website. That is safe.
